invariants: Each snapshot digest matches its canonical JSON bytes
The current pointer references an existing snapshot for the same GitHub issue
An older source update cannot replace a newer current snapshot
A local import is not acknowledged as remotely durable until its Git commit and push succeed
Workflow state identifies the same source issue, fixed branch, and current snapshot digest
Remote durability is acknowledged only when the branch ref resolves to the committed workflow revision

migration.strategy: Read schema version 1 snapshots; write a new version alongside old snapshots before switching readers
migration.rollback: Restore the previous current pointer and reader while retaining all snapshots
